item.title: Australian dollar gets a lift as the RBA delivers on a hawkish rate hike today
item.description: The decision to hike the cash rate was unanimous as the RBA produces a more hawkish tilt in their decision today. While the decision to hike in itself isn't surprising, it is more so the language that is accompanying the decision that is moving markets. item.title: What are the main events for today?
item.description: EUROPEAN SESSIONIn the European session, the only highlight is going to be the French CPI report. The CPI Y/Y is expected at 0.6% vs 0.8% prior, while the HICP Y/Y is seen at 0.6% vs 0.7% prior. Unless we see big deviations, the data is unlikely to change much for the ECB.
